## Editorial Standards

AI Nexus follows strict editorial standards to ensure every review is independent, accurate, and genuinely useful.

- **Independence**: No tool pays for a positive review. Affiliate relationships are disclosed in full. Editorial outcomes are never influenced by commercial partnerships.
- **Verification**: Every pricing claim is verified against official tool pages before publication. Review scores reflect aggregated data from G2, Trustpilot, and Capterra — not editorial opinion alone.
- **Freshness**: Tool reviews are checked and updated when pricing, features, or free plan terms change. The review date reflects when pricing and features were last verified.
- **Transparency**: The reviewer (Navneet Arya) is identified by name on every review page. Research methodology is documented at /methodology/.
- **Affiliate policy**: AI Nexus earns a commission when readers upgrade through affiliate links, at no cost to the reader. This never changes the editorial verdict.
